name: Dungeons narrator
direction: Warm, deliberate British female storytelling. Label it as Dungeons narration, not vanilla villager speech.
transcriptSource: Machine transcript (Whisper small.en), corrected by hand where it clearly misheard; not checked by listening.
transcript: The village is burning. No doubt this is the work of the evil Arch-Illager and his minions. They sweep across the land like a ravenous scourge, subjugating or destroying all in their path.

sample.phrase: This is a time for heroes like yourself. Make haste.
